facts.text: Product: Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress.
Selected configuration: Queen, 78 x 60 in (198 x 152 cm), 8 in (20.3 cm) high.
The product title describes Airknit fibres with latex.
Airboost is Duroflex’s proprietary open-matrix mattress technology, made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres; it is designed to improve airflow, movement response and postural support.
The mattress has a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex.
The product description says the Airboost layer and latex provide responsive support, breathability and pressure relief.
The reversible latex topper has firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other.
Flip the mattress to switch between the two firmness levels.
The zipper cover helps remove the cover and identify each side.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings are recommended to increase durability.
The Airboost technology uses an adaptive air-filament structure for stable support, improved airflow and easier movement during sleep.
The Airboost 6.8 features Arctic Ice cooling fabric, described as cool to the touch.
The product title advertises a 100-night sleep trial; the trial duration is unverified because the page also states 100 days.
The page states a 100-day sleep trial for Airboost mattresses; the trial duration is unverified because the product title states 100 nights.
The product page displays a 10-year warranty; the duration is unverified because another page passage gives a 7–10-year range depending on variant.
Airboost warranty duration is stated as 7–10 years depending on variant; the duration for this selected variant is unverified.
The Airboost manufacturer warranty covers manufacturing defects and material issues under normal-use conditions; the cited passage does not specify a duration.
